correctness.rationale: PASS. On B=max(Y_i)<1/2 the supporting tangent polygon has area A=sum_i tan(pi Y_i), and the Dirichlet beta marginal gives p=1-n[1-I_{1/2}(alpha,(n-1)alpha)]. At a nearly semicircular gap Y_i=1/2-O(1/x), its density tends to f(1/2)=2^(2-n alpha)/B(alpha,(n-1)alpha), giving each single pole probability f(1/2)/(pi x). Integrating the two-near-half-gap simplex corner is O(x^(-1-(n-2)alpha)), hence negligible. The max/sum squeeze yields constant n f(1/2)/(pi p), and the marginal endpoint rescaling tends to uniform U; the normalized other gaps have exact independent symmetric Dirichlet law, yielding J,U,Z,A/x -> J,U,Z,U^-1. Moment threshold q<1 follows by tail integration. These steps are correct, but were already essentially completed in the earlier November 2 proof.
